name: Kroger Customer Fulfillment Center Groveland FL

fieldNotes.truckGate: Sliding/cantilever gate across the secured-yard driveway off American Way, confirmed in Street View (pano NMgF_yqXrF21JG5vIG3SJA, Apr 2025) with perimeter chain-link/slatted fence and posted sign at the gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the road gate. The on-site control building with canopy bays sits deeper inside near the dock-yard throat, not at the public-road checkpoint, so the road entry reads as gate-without-booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no manned booth at the road entrance, implying call-box / kiosk / app check-in.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved apron / turnaround inside the gate before the dock yard provides queue room (the teardrop turnaround at ~28.6384,-81.8197).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long divided entry drive from American Way up to the yard can hold 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Divided entrance with multiple lanes and large unused paved apron width at the gate gives room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock bank with trailers backed in along the east building face; ~25-40 positions counted from z18/z20 imagery — band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated trailer drop/parking rows along the east apron and SE yard; ~25-50 trailer stalls. Note: large rows of small blue Kroger/Ocado delivery VANS in the south lot are fleet parking, not 53' trailers, and were excluded from trailer counts.
fieldNotes.dropYard: On-site trailer-storage rows separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park (Christopher C. Ford Commerce Park) on the rural fringe of Groveland by US-27, surrounded by open land, woods and a lake.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~58 ac fenced operational area traced; the full recorded parcel is reported at ~102.3 ac in CoStar/REBusinessOnline listings.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale visible in the truck path.
fieldNotes.note: Facility is the Kroger/Ocado automated CFC (FC-04, ~338-375k sq ft, four-story automated grid). Publicly reported as closed in 2025 as Kroger wound down its Ocado CFC network; imagery (2025-2026) still shows the building, fleet and trailers in place.
